status_summary: No 119th Congress bill limiting SEC investigations to two years or requiring an IG or GAO review of SEC IT spending was found in the searches run. The SEC Office of Inspector General's report list from 2025 through 2026-09-28 includes a 2025-06-24 management letter on consolidating disclosure review IT systems and a 2026-02-25 information security evaluation, neither of which is the IT spending and contracting review the Mandate describes. At a 2025-05-06 town hall the SEC Chairman mentioned a review of technology infrastructure and contracts, an internal step rather than the statutory report or time limit the Mandate asks Congress to require.
title: Limit SEC investigations to two years and require an IG or GAO report on SEC IT spending
uncertainties: Researcher ran two searches; the reviewer ran one more web search on 2026-10-14 for a bill on SEC investigation time limits and found only pre-2025 material on statutes of limitations. The OIG report list was read by title only, and GAO work was not checked. A bill might exist under different wording. The Chairman's mention of a technology and contract review is an announcement and is not treated as an event.
